about: The brawler's songs and sound effects: tools/port/build_snd.py builds the M ROM (KOF98's driver + these songs) and the V ROM (only their samples) and build/snd/songs.h (MUS_<name> = the driver command). source = the game whose driver the song comes from (kof98 = KOF98's own song, kept as is; others are ported into KOF98's format by tools/port/port98.py); cmd = the song's command in that game (docs/<game>_songs.md).

sfx.what: sound.h SFX_* (swings, hits) and fighter.c HIT_SFX (special-move hits, named by sound + the KOF98 moves using them: TODO #64); names: the options screen's SOUND PLAYER

songs.name: FIGHT
songs.what: Fatal Fury 3, Terry's stage (the stage fight)

songs.name: CONTINUE
songs.what: KOF98 continue countdown (measured in our emulator 2026-10-05: sent as the CONTINUE screen opens)

songs.name: GAME_OVER
songs.what: KOF98 loser's screen after the last defeat (measured 2026-10-05; KOF98's own GAME OVER plays $2C, our stage clear)

songs.name: BOSS_MR_BIG
songs.what: Art of Fighting 2, Mr. Big's stage (opponent 9, measured)

songs.name: BOSS_KRAUSER
songs.what: Fatal Fury Special, Krauser's stage, Kaiser Wave (68K stage table index 14 = Krauser)

songs.name: BOSS_GEESE
songs.what: Fatal Fury Special, Geese's stage (68K stage table index 13 = Geese)

songs.name: BOSS_GOENITZ
songs.what: KOF96, Goenitz's stage (68K stage table $4FC48 index 10 = team 10)

ssg.what: menu sounds (TODO #63): SSG cues on KOF98's own generated-sound path (command type 5), free commands $74-$77, data in the fixed area's free bytes (tools/port/ssg_cues.py); voices = SSG A, B, C: [note, ticks (13.9 ms), level 0-15]; build/snd/songs.h SSG_<name>

voices.what: the fighters' voices (TODO #55): only the ones game.json's roster maps (export_bm.py writes build/voice_map.json), copied from each fighter's game's V ROM; one code per voice in slot 2 ($1C, players) and slot 3 ($1E, enemies): build/snd/voices.h
